rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR EMERGENT STUDIES / Emergent Studies

criteria.description: Requested imaging was required to render immediate medical attention needed to prevent loss of life, limb, or risk of permanent disability (e.g. airway/breathing/circulation compromise, acute compartment syndrome, acute vascular thrombosis/embolus)

required_documentation: Emergency department or inpatient records documenting acute life/limb threatening clinical emergency at the time of imaging
rules.review_notes: Emergent retrospective review requires physician clinical determination of life/limb threat.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR URGENT STUDIES / Urgent Studies

criteria.description: Condition required prompt medical intervention to prevent progression to an emergent condition or could not be postponed for 24 hours without substantial risk of harm

required_documentation: Physician progress notes documenting urgent clinical progression risk justifying retrospective approval
rules.review_notes: Urgent retrospective review requires physician clinical evaluation of 24-hour urgency.
